items.title: 16.9 Resistor ke zariye discharge hote capacitor ka exponential decay (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of exponential decay of a discharging capacitor (PDF 78-80).

blocks.text: Jab capacitor resistor ke zariye discharge hota hai (Fig 16.13 a) to us ka charge waqt ke saath exponential tor par ghatta hai (Fig 16.14). Exponential function ki shakal f(x) = a^x hai, jis mein variable exponent mein aata hai. RC circuit mein discharge hote capacitor ka aam formula x = xo exp(-t/RC), ya x = xo e^(-t/RC) (16.43) hai, jahan x waqt t par miqdar (charge, voltage ya current), xo t = 0 par us ki ibtidai qeemat, R ohms mein resistance, C farads mein capacitance, t seconds mein waqt aur RC time constant tau hai. Adad e, taqreeban 2.718, natural logarithms ki bunyaad (Euler number) hai. Manfi exponent batata hai ke miqdar waqt ke saath ghatti hai.

blocks.alt: Discharge hote capacitor ke charge aur waqt ka graph: curve oonchai se shuru ho kar pehle tezi se aur phir ahista ahista girta hai aur waqt ke mehwar ke qareeb hamwar ho jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.14: Discharge hote capacitor ka charge aur waqt (kitab ki Figure 16.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yun charge, voltage aur current sab aik tarah girte hain: Q = Qo e^(-t/RC), V = Vo e^(-t/RC) aur I = Io e^(-t/RC). Graphs tezi se (tez discharge) shuru ho kar ahista ahista chapte ho jate hain. Barabar waqfon mein charge barabar hisse (fraction) se girta hai, is liye har waqfe mein kami charge kam hone ke saath chhoti hoti jati hai (Fig 16.15). Yeh tanki se patle pipe ke zariye pani nikalne jaisa hai: tanki bhari ho to dabao zyada aur pani tez behta hai; satah girne par bahao sust ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Qo se shuru hone wala charge aur waqt ka graph. Pehle waqfe t ke baad charge Q hai. Baad mein, utne hi lambe waqfe t mein, charge Qo' se Q' tak girta hai, jo kahin chhoti kami hai. Dashed lakeerein charge ke mehwar par Q, Qo' aur Q' dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.15: Barabar waqfon t mein charge ki kami (kitab ki Figure 16.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Exponential functions physics ke bohat se amal bayan karte hain, jaise radioactive decay, jis mein kisi miqdar ki tabdeeli ki sharah us ki maujooda qeemat par barah-e-raast munhasir hai.

Q = Qo e^(-t/RC) mein t = RC rakhne se Q = Qo e^-1 = Qo / 2.718 = 0.37 Qo. Yun time constant woh waqt hai jis mein ibtidai charge Qo taqreeban 0.37 Qo tak gir jata hai: aik time constant ke baad charge (aur isi tarah voltage aur current) apni ibtidai qeemat ka 37 feesad reh jata hai. Chhota time constant ka matlab circuit tez jawab deta hai (Fig 16.16).

Half-life: woh waqt t1/2 jis mein charge apni ibtidai qeemat ka aadha reh jaye. Q = Qo/2 rakhne par: 1/2 = e^(-t1/2 / RC), is liye ln(1/2) = -t1/2 / RC aur t1/2 = -RC ln(1/2) = RC ln 2 (16.44). Kyunke ln 2 = 0.693, t1/2 = 0.69 RC (16.45).

blocks.alt: Qo se shuru hone wala charge aur waqt ka graph. Dashed lakeerein dikhati hain ke 0.69RC ke baad charge Qo ka aadha aur aik time constant RC ke baad 0.37Qo reh jata hai; dono waqt origin se waqt ke mehwar par teeron se dikhaye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.16: Charge 0.69RC mein Qo ka aadha aur aik time constant RC mein 0.37Qo reh jata hai (kitab ki Figure 16.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: ln 2 aur chhape hawale
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai 'calculator se -ln(2) = -0.6' aur phir 0.69 use karti hai; ln 2 = 0.693. Yeh 'Eq. 4.45' aur 'Fig. 4.17' ka hawala bhi deti hai, jin se murad equation 16.45 aur Fig 16.16 hain, aur yeh hissa 14.9 chhapa hai.

RC circuit mein R = 1 kilo-ohm, C = 100 uF aur Vo = 10 V hai. 0.2 s baad capacitor par voltage maloom karein. Hal: tau = RC = (1000 ohm)(100 x 10^-6 F) = 0.1 s. V = Vo e^(-t/RC) = 10 e^(-0.2/0.1) = 10 e^-2 = 10 / (2.718)^2 = 1.35 V.

blocks.prompt: Misal 16.10 ke circuit mein voltage ko 5 V tak girne mein kitna waqt lagega?
blocks.explanation: 5 V, 10 V ka aadha hai, is liye t = t1/2 = 0.69 RC = 0.69 x 0.1 s = 0.069 s.

items: Charge, voltage aur current ke liye x = xo e^(-t/RC).
RC ke baad: shuru ka 0.37; half-life t1/2 = 0.69 RC.
